rules.agent_slow_ratio: an agent took more than 2x its typical time -> amber
rules.llm_fail_rate_amber: more than 3% of LLM attempts failed -> amber
rules.llm_fail_rate_red: more than 10% of LLM attempts failed -> red
rules.llm_tail_ratio: p95 latency above 4x the median -> amber (a long tail of slow calls)
rules.llm_cache_amber: less than 30% of input tokens served from cache -> amber
rules.llm_cache_red: less than 10% cached -> red (the prompt prefix is not stable)
rules.mem_amber: memory above 80% of the pool -> amber
rules.mem_red: memory above 92% of the pool -> red (an OOM kill is close)
rules.disk_amber_gib: less than 10 GiB of disk free -> amber
rules.solo_share: more than 40% of the run had a single agent working -> a serial bottleneck
rules.dominant_share: one agent took more than 35% of the run -> the critical-path bottleneck
rules.saturated_share: LLM calls were at the worker limit for more than 60% of LLM-busy time -> worker-bound
rules.queue_wait_share: agents waited >5% of the run for the Governor to admit them
rules.rewrite_guard_amber: any file needed the rule-by-rule rewrite fallback -> amber; files that kept their original text -> red

advice.commit_rewrite: The single history rewrite is blob-bound (every file version is transformed, with an AST syntax guard on changed Python). Fewer renamed identifiers (scope the rename to symbols whose every reference is in scope) and more rewrite processes (--procs) shorten it.
advice.validation_head: Test run on the renamed tree. Fewer / smaller test files (--max-files), more xdist workers (--jobs), or a warmer pip cache (RQ_SHARED_CACHE) shorten it. The baseline is already reused.
advice.baseline: Runs the ORIGINAL's tests in parallel with the LLM stages; it only costs wall-clock if it outlasts them. Dependency installs dominate: check missing_deps logs.
advice.mapper: Scan of the whole history plus the closed-world analysis. More --procs shortens it; it is skipped on --resume.
advice.val_engine: Re-runs the tests on the delivered tree. If the delivered tree equals the validated one the engine can skip it.
advice.v_functional: History structure check. It is incremental now; if it is still slow, raise RQ_CHECK_PROCS.
advice.v_anonymity: Includes the full-history scan (parallel by object slices); raise --procs.
advice.final_pass: Mutation + test changes + its own test runs. --max-repairs 0 and a smaller --max-verify-files shorten it.
advice.assembler: Naming pass = a second history rewrite. Merging it into the first rewrite would remove it.
advice.commit_msgs: LLM-bound: more LLM workers (up to ~12), or fewer commits reworded in full (--scope-prs).
advice.names: LLM-bound: fewer rename candidates shorten it directly.
advice.pr_texts: LLM-bound: titles for all, full text only for the scoped PRs.
advice.architect: Reading the extracts and building the timeline; scales with PR/issue count.
